topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: That neighbor comes knockin' on my door with talk of a garden. Said he's been watchin' my yard, how the sun hits just right, perfect for tomatoes and bell peppers. Man's got the green thumb, alright, and he shows me a sketch, neat as a pin, of what he’s plannin'. Figured I’d give him a nod. Ain’t like I’m usin’ that corner for much, and something tells me this could spruce up the joint without me liftin' a finger. Guess you could say I’m feelin' charitable today. After all, a little green life around here might not be such a bad thing.
